name: Rain's Maple Quiz 6

other.description: Answer the NPC quiz question correctly on completion (see dialogue.on_completion.quiz).

journal.raw:
Time to answer Rain's 6th question.
And next, the sixth question.
I learned that when I level up, I get AP. If I use the AP on the stats I want, I can make them stronger. I'll make sure to remember that.

entries: I learned that when I level up, I get AP. If I use the AP on the stats I want, I can make them stronger. I'll make sure to remember that.

lines.text: Wow, you're pretty good. Are you assigning your Ability Points (AP) well? You know you get those after leveling up, right? Talk to me when you're ready for the 6th question.

segments.text: Wow, you're pretty good. Are you assigning your Ability Points (AP) well? You know you get those after leveling up, right? Talk to me when you're ready for the 6th question.

chips.title: This NPC asks you a quiz question

question.text: If you keep up with your adventures, you can level up and earn AP to boost your stats. Do you know how much AP you get with each level?

segments.text: If you keep up with your adventures, you can level up and earn AP to boost your stats. Do you know how much AP you get with each level?

quiz.wrong_answer_heading: If you pick the wrong answer

wrong_answer_responses.text: Come on, you get more than 1 measly point!

segments.text: Come on, you get more than 1 measly point!

correct_answer_response.text: That's right. You get 5 AP with each level, and you can use them on the stats you want in Character Info to make your character stronger. Be sure to remember that!

notes: quiz.correct_choice_index 2 ("5 points") is inferred from MeowDB's own dialogue, not from a MeowDB correct-answer marker: the "When you answer correctly" line says "You get 5 AP with each level"; "If you pick the wrong answer" answers the other choice "1 point" with "Come on, you get more than 1 measly point!"; "If you pick the wrong answer" answers the other choice "2 points" with "Nope, not 2 points. Think again.".

Quiz choices are listed in MeowDB document order, which is the in-game selection order (#L0, #L1, ...; quiz 6 leaks a raw "#L2" tag exactly at position 2). MeowDB renders the choice rows nested inside each other (a markup artifact); the extractor flattens them in document order. choices[].correct is MeowDB's marker: true = marked "Correct answer", false = rendered as an option and not marked, null = option reconstructed from unparsed game markup (raw_markup). Wrong-answer responses are listed in MeowDB order and are not linked to a specific choice by MeowDB.
gaps: MeowDB marks no quiz choice as the correct answer, and shows the last option only as unparsed game markup ("#L2 # 5 points"); that option is reconstructed in choices with correct: null.
MeowDB has no maximum level for quests (max_level is null).
MeowDB has no map-visit objectives or per-objective map restrictions for quests.
MeowDB does not say which "On completion" lines are shown before vs after the reward is given, or how dialogue pages are split into NPC chat windows.
